sub_site: breast tumour and non-cancerous adjacent breast tissue (TCGA BRCA RNA-seq); 16S validation on 6 fresh-frozen tumours

data_source.dataset: TCGA BRCA RNA-seq (unmapped reads); plus own 16S on 6 Mayo Clinic TCGA tissue blocks

evidence.quote: We utilized The Cancer Genome Atlas, (TCGA) breast cancer data to perform a novel experiment utilizing unmapped and mapped RNA sequencing read evidence
the reads unaligned to the host genome were aligned by Kraken to its bacterial genome (03–2014 build) and bacterial 16S ribosomal databases
The V3-V5 region of the 16S-rRNA gene were amplified with a two-step PCR protocol

controls.types: DNA extraction blank; PCR NTC (16S validation subset only; none for TCGA RNA-seq)

evidence.quote: In order to control for contamination we included negative controls of the DNA extraction and PCR amplification solutions. Minimal artefactual read evidence was observed
as a result of the spiked in DNA enrichment step (14 and 10 reads) and therefore subtracted from our sample cohort
We further applied a set of filters to remove rare microbial OTUs, those presented in less than 25% of our study cohort

notes: Main dataset TCGA RNA-seq (668 tumour + 72 NCA), Kraken; TCGA plate batch effect noted (198 OTUs). 16S (V3-V5) on 6 tumours with extraction/PCR negative controls; Geobacillus (spike-in artefact) subtracted. Controls/decontam apply only to 16S subset. Several genera (Escherichia, Corynebacterium, Bacillus, Salmonella) named as own findings only in Discussion. Neisseria named only as 'N. Subflava' (not recorded).
